description:
Admin: flag/unflag a meter as test/synthetic so its events are
    excluded from usage statistics by default. Touches meter metadata only —
    never events, never the hash chain, never billing accruals. Requires the
    server's VIRIDIS_ADMIN_TOKEN.

admin_token.description: The server's admin token. Required for this admin action.
admin_token.title: Admin Token

is_test.description: True to flag the meter as test traffic, false to clear it.
is_test.title: Is Test

meter_id.description: The meter id returned by create_meter.
meter_id.title: Meter Id

name: flag_meter
title: Flag meter
